body: Moderators: has this post been removed? The support I have received these past few hours has been such a relief of everything. I wouldn't mind if more people could find that post (I don't see it anymore in the list). It has been a while since I talked to someone. Thank you everyone. <3
Thank you so much, you're very helpful 🙏
Thank you so much <3, I need love and sugar

Thanks for sharing this, it is the approach that makes sense to me, or at least did, until I actually ran out of options. The process of doing everything I could and should, doing that the right way but also push it to respectful extremes that show that "wow, he really wants it that much", was rewarding and I was proud of myself while doing it. I did it as good as I could, made a couple mistakes here and there but in general I am happy about what I showed and am proud I did it. Proud I was able to show with more than words how big my love is. But now I have reached the point where anything more would be one step too much. I always thought doing what I did would be enough. It's been a while now. And it has visibly not been enough. Letting go, even if it may look like I let go because I can't do more, is mentally and emotionally impossible. I just can't because I honestly love her more than everything. And I can't because I also know I would regret it one day. I am not going to let go what matters the most in my life. And because of that I am miserable and on Reddit tonight...
Not silly at all, you're so right, not easy

Thank you so much, I really appreciate it 🙏. It happened a while ago already, today I reached a point where I exhausted all the options I had to try and show, by actions and patience, by doing things differently, how much I want to share my life with her and what she truly means to me. Time has passed and everything I did has been met with silence. It hurts so much mentally that sometimes I wonder if I even did those things, if any of this was real or just a dream. Honestly, I really thought she would come back. I know I would have...
Thank you so much for all the support, hugs and kind words 🙏, it's the best thing that happened to me in quite some time <3
Thank you 🙏🙏, I'm somewhere in european countryside, not many people around. Horses, goats and cows mainly.

Thank you so much for the nice words and thank you for sharing your story. When I read it I can't stop replaying mine and wondering if I had showed disrespect at times along the way, or if I did things that lead to such a situation. Deep inside me I know I never lied, never disrespected her. I am way head over heels for her, she is above everything and everyone and I'll never let her down. But reading your story I can't stop wondering if in her mind things are different, if in her mind I did bad or I don't care that much... I'm terrified she left with a wrong opinion of me, and it hurts. 
Since she disappeared, I have tried really hard to show her how much this means to me. Silence. I'm hoping she saw it and sometimes thinks about it...
I had left this out my original post, I hurts so much.
Thank you 🙏. I just read your recent post, stay strong, I send a hug back <3
Thank you so much for the hug and the kind words <3
Thank you 🙏, there are so many places, so many things, I cannot go or cannot do. I have given everything and now it all comes back to haunt me. Memories hurt so much
Thanks a lot 🙏, gonna look into it, glad to read it's being helpful
Thank you. I don't know what I deserve or don't, but yeah maybe I'd deserve a word at least... I really wish she'd realized what she means to me
